description.en: Positions and sets the motion of a high-detail dialogue model (a "hi model"), waiting for it to load first. Its position/scale is picked from a lookup table keyed by the character's base model ID (or, for a few special-cased base IDs, hardcoded offsets), with a left/right mirror applied when _stdPos is EV_CHARA_POS_RIGHT. Also registers the model's display name for the talk system when a base ID is given.
Handle of the hi-model to position.
Standard dialogue position slot (e.g. EV_CHARA_POS_RIGHT) selecting which side of the screen to place the model.
3-element array [motionId0, motionId1, motionId2] passed to CMND_SET_MOTION_ID.
Optional base model ID used to look up position/scale and register the talk display name (defaults to "").
Optional numeric base ID fallback used when _baseID is empty (defaults to 0).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
